text: Agile methodology is a popular approach to project management, especially in software development. Instead of working on a huge project all at once, teams use an iterative process. They break the work into small, manageable pieces, which they complete in short periods called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Each day, the team holds a brief standup meeting to share progress and discuss any obstacles. A prioritized backlog contains all the tasks, often written as user stories to describe features from the customer's perspective. This flexible system allows the team to adapt quickly to changes and deliver valuable results continuously.
